selection_rules.ordering: median stage-4 Sharpe (local_perturbation) desc, profitable dev years desc, dev Sharpe desc, config_id asc

holdout_selection.plan: Score #649 on 2025+ with the config acceptance rules, on its own.
holdout_selection.rationale: Chosen by the user (2026-11-24) as a clean intraday replacement after the wick-entry picks were found to skip 15-minute bars that break both box edges (see minute_resolve_*.json). Close entries decide on the bar close and fill at the next open, so that ambiguity cannot arise. Proposed by Claude from the NR close-entry validation passers on ES, ranked by 2023-2024 Sharpe with dev Sharpe and profitable dev years as a check -- so validation WAS used to pick it, and it is the top of a large pool (expect regression). Every position is flat by the session close.
